on.sql: SELECT c.id,count(*) rows,count(v.id) videos FROM channels c LEFT JOIN videos v ON v.channel_id=c.id AND v.status='published' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id

where.sql: SELECT c.id,count(v.id) videos FROM channels c LEFT JOIN videos v ON v.channel_id=c.id WHERE v.status='published' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id

multiplication.sql: SELECT v.id,vt.tag_id,f.user_id FROM videos v JOIN video_tags vt ON vt.video_id=v.id JOIN favorites f ON f.video_id=v.id WHERE v.id=1 AND f.user_id IN(1,2,3) ORDER BY vt.tag_id,f.user_id

distinct.sql: SELECT count(*) combinations,count(DISTINCT vt.tag_id) tags,count(DISTINCT f.user_id) favorites FROM videos v JOIN video_tags vt ON vt.video_id=v.id JOIN favorites f ON f.video_id=v.id WHERE v.id=1 AND f.user_id IN(1,2,3)

preaggregate.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT video_id,count(*) tags FROM video_tags GROUP BY video_id),f AS(SELECT video_id,count(*) favorites FROM favorites WHERE user_id IN(1,2,3) GROUP BY video_id) SELECT v.id,t.tags,f.favorites FROM videos v LEFT JOIN t ON t.video_id=v.id LEFT JOIN f ON f.video_id=v.id WHERE v.id=1
